rate_policy.note: Read-only stock history beyond the Basic two-year window supports paid-stock-tier access; official paid stocks plans allow unlimited calls. Keep a paced stock-only client and fall back on HTTP429. No plan changes, and futures/crypto defaults stay unchanged.

notes: All 65 candidate instruments use original 5m confirmed-retest / 2R rules. Original sessions, two entries per asset/day, stops, costs and capital/risk controls stay fixed. No frequency-study wider hours or repeated entries.

Training screening uses the unchanged pool_protocol.json thresholds, completed pre-May trades, higher-cost stress and three early time blocks. top5_65 retains the existing maximum-five / one-per-exposure-bucket rule. eligible65 enables every training-eligible asset to test more possible markets; it does not rank using later returns.

all29 and all65 enable their entire predefined universes regardless of training results. Trade allocation remains alphabetical at a shared minute open, with 1% entry risk, 2% aggregate open risk, two concurrent positions, one equity-index future, 3% daily loss budget and capital reservations unchanged.

Use fresh $50k accounts on May-November and the same observed MNQ market-date clock. Reuse the 29 unchanged candidate journals and prior same-date all17, selected29 and MCL benchmarks with explicit provenance. Only the 36 additional candidates and eight new portfolio simulations require new replay.

Names are predefined surviving instruments, not a historical index universe, random sample, or proof of asset independence. Stock/ETF shorts and settled cash/broker buying power remain unmodeled. Intraminute paths are hypothetical and margin proxies are static.

Publish all candidates, unavailable data, training eligibility, all portfolio cases and fixed-fill stress. No new risk increase, target optimization, entry filter, rule search or live orders. This is another retrospective experiment on already inspected dates; increasing the search space also increases selection bias.

selection_policy.purpose: Find a more profitable tradable CHoCH pool without ranking on the later-period result. This is a retrospective extension of an already inspected year.
selection_policy.score: minimum across paths of mean stressed net R per completed training trade times sqrt(training trade count); descending, symbol alphabetical tie-break
notes: Freeze the 5m entry logic, costs, risk, sessions and capital constraints. Only market membership changes. Full initial-margin planning proxies and 1% entry / 2% total planned risk are inherited from portfolio_protocol.json.

Training includes only trades both entered and exited before the cutoff. Exclude unverified roll_data_end_mark and end_of_data liquidations from training selection. No later-period trade, statistic or equity curve enters the selector.

Reprice training fills with the existing breadth-study cost stress. No new cost threshold or parameter grid is optimized. At most five eligible markets, at most one per declared coarse exposure bucket; fewer are allowed and none means cash.

New ETFs use the stock engine, whole shares, 1x notional, regular-session candles, assumed stock costs, and hypothetical shorts with unmodeled borrow availability/charges. The sample is predefined surviving instruments, not a point-in-time universe or random sample.

The earlier full-history screened-five basket is a hindsight-selected comparator. The primary selected basket is tested against all-17 5m, that earlier basket, and MCL 5m alone on the same later half with fresh $50k accounts and complete earlier history for indicator warmup.
Use observed MNQ futures market dates as a common day-count clock, including zero-trade dates even if the selected basket has only ETFs/stocks. MNQ need not be trade-enabled.

Publish all candidate eligibility/ranks, later-period cases, full-period selected-pool capital scenarios, source/input hashes and explicit unavailable downloads. Do not try a second selection rule after viewing the first result.

This year was already inspected in prior studies. A chronological split reduces direct selection leakage but is not pristine out-of-sample validation. No claim of guaranteed profits, statistical significance or universal optimum. No live orders or default strategy changes.

access_probe.inference: Historical depth supports paid stocks access; paced shared client, not an account billing lookup.
